armor.name: Aetheric Vest
armor.description: Aetheric Vest. Aether-thread cloth bound to a shard lattice — turns aside blade and stray Aetheric current alike.

armor.name: Tyrant's Crown
armor.description: Tyrant's Crown. A circlet of cooled mud-iron, set with shards pried from broken siegework. The Mud Tyrant wore it as proof he had outlasted the kings before him.

armor.name: Hollow Crown
armor.description: Hollow Crown. Bone fused to tarnished gold, weightless in the hand. Its wearer hears the throne-room arguments of a kingdom that drowned.

armor.name: Worm Plating
armor.description: Worm Plating. Overlapping iron scutes stripped from the Iron Worm's flank. They still shift when warmed, as if remembering the coil.

armor.name: Matriarch's Carapace
armor.description: Matriarch's Carapace. A back-plate cut from the Voidspawn Matriarch's brood-shell. Cooled to glass, it weeps a faint resin that knits its own cracks.

armor.name: Reaver's Pauldron
armor.description: Reaver's Pauldron. A massive shoulder-piece of scavenged steel, lashed across the chest with mud-bone cord. Notched once for every warband the Reaver broke.

armor.name: Lich-Bone Mantle
armor.description: Lich-Bone Mantle. Vertebrae of an old Aetheric Lich strung on Aetheric thread. Cold to the touch, and quieter than cloth ought to be.

armor.name: Wyrm-Scale Hide
armor.description: Wyrm-Scale Hide. Bog-tanned scales from the Bog Wyrm, each one still slick with the venom that cured them. Light, supple, and faintly toxic to handle bare.

armor.name: Behemoth Plate
armor.description: Behemoth Plate. Hammered from the fused ribs of an Aetheric Behemoth. Heavy as a door, and shrugs off a falling beam the same way.
